evidence: The body checks a byte at input+0x428, optionally resolves a context value whose low 16-bit flags must include bits 1 or 2, then returns the input integer when it is in range, 16 for values above 15, or -2 for rejected/negative cases. Its caller passes an integer-converted attribute result and uses the return within a larger player-attribute routine, but the exact slot/domain meaning is unclear. decompiled/main/main_0119.c:13417-13458; caller decompiled/main/main_0117.c:13240-13248.

Queries context selector 0x15. It returns true when status 1 pairs with the global service word at 0x700227e6a0 being 1, or status 2 pairs with that word being 0; otherwise it returns false. Callers use the result as a Boolean condition. decompiled/main/main_0006.c:31206-31243; caller decompiled/main/main_0007.c:21071-21076.

The body first requires get_attribute_context_status_32 to equal 3, then sums two helper-returned byte values and compares the result with another returned value minus one, returning a Boolean. Its caller stores this Boolean alongside many other status-derived values in an aggregate, but the precise condition being counted is unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0116.c:5098-5133; caller decompiled/main/main_0113.c:23250-23260.

Initializes an output slot, obtains the context record-array base, resolves index x0 only for indices 0..2 to an entry at base + index*0x148 + 0xa8, then calls player_attribute_value_or_zero(entry, 0x11) and returns that float converted to a signed integer. The direct caller uses the result as a computed value after its context predicate succeeds. decompiled/main/main_0033.c:5319-5352; decompiled/main/main_0171.c:1126-1155; caller decompiled/main/main_0120.c:25208-25219.

For the supplied output record, writes the context getter result for selector 0x13 to offset +0x0c. If that result is not 6 and the global word at 0x7003abfc00+4 equals 3, it overwrites the field with 9; then returns the stored 32-bit value. Its caller invokes it on a local record assembled by the preceding helper. decompiled/main/main_0094.c:40279-40310; caller decompiled/main/main_0030.c:11388-11396.
